scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Beards! Get your wonderful beards!
Would you like a beard?
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
胡子！快来买你漂亮的胡子吧！
你想要一副胡子吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I'd like some facial hair!
scripts.translation: 是的，我想要一些面部毛发！

scripts.text: No thanks, thats gross!
scripts.translation: 不用了，那太恶心了！

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
HoHo~ So you want some whiskers.
Well I would give you my beards but there not cheap.
Matter of fact I have only one left...
but I'm not selling it.
But don't get mad! I can make you one.
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
呵呵~ 原来你想要一副胡渣。
我本来可以给你我的胡子，但它们可不便宜。
事实上，我只剩最后一副了...
但我并不打算卖掉它。
不过别生气！我可以给你做一副。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
I would need some ^8080FFThread^000000 for the Beard.
Talk to my friend in Izlude for some ^8080FFThread^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
制作胡子需要一些^8080FF线^000000。
去依斯鲁得岛找我的朋友拿一些^8080FF线^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Also I would need you to get me some things for the beard.
They are:
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
此外，我还需要你帮我收集一些制作胡子的材料。
它们分别是：

scripts.text:
^8080FFElastic Band^000000
^8080FF5 Animal Skins^000000
^8080FFBlack Dye Stuff^000000
^8080FFGranpa Beard^000000
^8080FF100 sticky Mucus^000000
^8080FFCounteragent^000000
 and one ^8080FF2 Carat Diamond^000000

[Bearded Man]
Fine, be that way!
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
好吧，那就随你吧！

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Sorry, I can only make one per person.
We don't want too many beards now. Right?
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
抱歉，每个人只能做一副。
我们不希望有太多胡子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Let's make you your beard!
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
让我们为你制作一副胡子吧！

scripts.text: ^8080FF~You see him cutting and sewing the beard together~^000000
scripts.translation: ^8080FF~你看着他裁剪并缝合胡子~^000000

scripts.text: ^8080FF~He hands you the finished beard~^000000
scripts.translation: ^8080FF~他把做好的胡子递给你~^000000

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
Have a nice day!
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
祝你愉快！

scripts.text:
[Bearded Man]
What the hell! I can't make a beard without the items!
Here is the list again:
scripts.translation:
[大胡子男子]
天哪！没有材料我怎么做胡子啊！
这是材料清单：

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Good evening! I am the Master Tailor!
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
晚上好！我是裁缝大师！

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
What? A Bearded Man sent you...
Well I'm sorry to say that I am out of ^8080FFThread^000000.
But I have the address to where I get the shipments.
It is in Al de Baran Kafra Inc. warehouse area.
The address is: Al de Baran 59, 221
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
什么？是大胡子男子派你来的...
很抱歉，我的^8080FF线^000000用完了。
但我有进货地址。
在艾尔帕兰卡普拉公司的仓库区。
地址是：艾尔帕兰 59, 221
回头见。

scripts.text: [Kafra Clerk]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉 职员]

scripts.text:
[Kafra Clerk]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: What's in the boxes?
scripts.translation: 箱子里有什么？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Clerk]
They're empty.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
它们是空的。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Clerk]
Sorry but we have not received any ^8080FFThread^000000.
Our shipments have been put off until its safe.
You see we get our ^8080FFThread^000000 from Alberta and a monsters keeps attacking our merchants.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
抱歉，我们还没有收到任何^8080FF线材^000000。
为了安全起见，我们的运输已经暂停了。
您看，我们的^8080FF线材^000000是从艾尔贝塔运来的，但一直有魔物袭击我们的商人。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Clerk]
Now this monsters has not been doing this before.
It may have to do with the warmer months.
Please help us out!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
这只魔物以前可没这么做过。
也许是因为天气变暖的缘故。
请帮帮我们吧！

scripts.text: [Kafra Clerk]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉 职员]

scripts.text: Oh by the way, that Thread Merchant is somewhere around Alberta 60 and 100...
scripts.translation: 对了，那位线材商人大概在艾尔贝塔60到100的区域...

scripts.text: Thank You!
scripts.translation: 谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
ARGGG!! I can never get my stuff to Al de Baran!
I keep getting mobbed by some bugs.
They steal all my supplies and ^8080FFThread^000000.
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
啊——！！我的货永远也送不到艾尔帕兰了！
我老是遭到一群虫子的围攻。
它们偷走了我所有的补给品和^8080FF线材^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What am I to do?
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
我该怎么办？

scripts.text: [Thread Merchant]
scripts.translation: [线材商人]

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What am I to do?
Kill! Kill them already!!!
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
我该怎么办？
杀了它们！快杀了它们！！！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Kill! Kill them already!!!
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
杀了它们！快杀了它们！！！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What am I to do?
Kill! Kill them already!!!
Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
我该怎么办？
杀了它们！快杀了它们！！！
你是来帮我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Kill! Kill them already!!!
Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
杀了它们！快杀了它们！！！
你是来帮我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What am I to do?
Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
我该怎么办？
你是来帮我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Are you here to help me?
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
你是来帮我的吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Oh thank the Gods!
If you can only just kill the bugs I would be able to make my delivery.
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
感谢神明！
如果你能帮我把那些虫子杀掉，我就能完成送货了。

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Oh NO! Here they come!!
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
啊不！它们来了！！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Thank you for killing the Thief Bugs.
As a token of my gratitude here is a box full of ^8080FFThread^000000.
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
谢谢你杀掉了那些浮勒盗虫。
作为感谢，这里有一箱^8080FF线材^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
Thank you again!
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
再次感谢！

scripts.text:
[Thread Merchant]
What to do...
scripts.translation:
[线材商人]
该怎么办呢...
